-- Share of each 2025 cohort that ordered again within 3 months
WITH orders_ok AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_date,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', order_date) AS INTEGER) * 12
           + CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_index
  FROM orders
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         MIN(month_index) AS cohort_index,
         strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(order_date)) AS cohort
  FROM orders_ok
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
activity AS (
  SELECT f.cohort, o.customer_id, o.month_index - f.cohort_index AS month_number
  FROM orders_ok AS o
  JOIN firsts AS f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  cohort,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_number BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS repeat_3m_pct
FROM activity
WHERE cohort BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-09'
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort;

WITH orders_ok AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_date,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', order_date) AS INTEGER) * 12
           + CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_index
  FROM orders
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         MIN(month_index) AS cohort_index,
         strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(order_date)) AS cohort
  FROM orders_ok
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
activity AS (
  SELECT f.cohort, o.customer_id, o.month_index - f.cohort_index AS month_number
  FROM orders_ok AS o
  JOIN firsts AS f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  cohort,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE month_number BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 1) AS repeat_3m_pct
FROM activity
WHERE cohort BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-09'
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort;
